text_block_list.text:
Though Air Groove narrowly missed out on 
victory—

text_block_list.name: Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
That was awesome, Air Groove!! You were so 
close!!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
You're my new queen, Air Groove!! Good 
luck next time too—!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...The frustration lingers. But the fans 
still embraced my run.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Senpai carries herself with such 
confidence...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder if I can do it too. Just like 
that—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Eyes are upon me. Especially when facing 
a disappointing result... my conduct 
matters.)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Therefore—I cannot afford to give in 
here!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Just let me say this one thing.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I wasn't able to achieve a 
satisfactory result.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"This is not your responsibility. It was 
my own inadequacy. Therefore—"
choice_data_list:
Let's aim for an even better result in the 
Shuka Sho than today!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah. That was my intention from the 
start.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...You seem far more forward-looking than 
I. Just for today, perhaps I shall follow 
your lead.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Let's go. Toward the final battle of the 
Triple Tiara.

Together with Air Groove, a new fire was 
lit in our hearts for the final battle!
